newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy to buy N.M. well rig operator.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy to buy N.M. well rig operator.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to buy Cobra Industries Inc, which operates 26 large well service rigs in southeast New Mexico, for about $7 million in cash and stock.

Key Energy said the acquisition would significantly expand its operations in the Permian Basin of West Texas to an adjacent area in New Mexico. It said it expected Cobra's rigs to add annual revenues of more than $7 million, and that the business would continue to operate under the Cobra name.
The deal was expected to close in January 1997, Key said.

"This acquisition is significant in that it represents the first expansion of our company into what we feel is a strong well services market in New Mexico," said Francis John, chairman, president and chief executive officer.
Key Energy would assume Cobra's strong balance sheet, consisting of real estate, minimal debt and a positive net working capital position, John said.
